title: OptionQuoteResult
description: Plan-2A R-AA-2: result of GetOptionQuoteActivity.getOptionQuote. A one-shot NBBO snapshot mapped from the market-data-svc internal Quote(bid,mid,ask,retrievedAt) record. status=FAILED is returned (not thrown) so the bounded-flatten path can fall back to a marketable exit and emit a loud availability audit instead of going into Temporal retry. When status=UNAVAILABLE the provider returned no snapshot (Optional.empty); bid/mid/ask are absent.

contract_symbol.description: OCC option symbol the snapshot is for (echoed from the request).

bid.description: NBBO bid premium per contract, dollars. Absent when status != OK.

mid.description: Provider-computed mid premium per contract, dollars. Absent when status != OK.

ask.description: NBBO ask premium per contract, dollars. Absent when status != OK.

retrieved_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp when the snapshot was taken (or attempted).

status.description: OK: bid/mid/ask present. UNAVAILABLE: provider returned no snapshot. FAILED: the snapshot call threw; returned (not thrown) so the workflow can fall back to a marketable exit and audit.
